name: r-mango-cloud
description: A personal project, still in development — a cloud storage built from scratch, as a naive idea put into practice. Open to ideas, suggestions or help from any angle.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,ADMIN -k -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix mango-api -- --port 3000" "npm run dev --prefix mango-web -- --port 5173" "npm run dev --prefix mango-admin -- --port 5174"
